lines.text: [excited] What if you could just... describe the app you need?
Jig turns a sentence into a real native app, on iPhone and Android. And you change it just by pointing.
Every app gets storage, reminders that work while it's closed, and data it can share with your other apps.
It can think with Meta's AI, and see with SAM.
Muse Spark builds it, and checks its own work.
[delighted] A real native app. On iPhone, and Android.
It'll even remind me while it's closed.
Want a change? Point at it, and say it.
[warmly] Describe it. Use it. Change it. That's Jig.
